ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will check for a Merchant Number before a renewal's stage is changed to Statements In.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZwl", ISPICKVAL(Type, "RENEWAL"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Statements In - MCA"), Merchant_Number__c="")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before changing the stage to Statements In, you must populate the Merchant Number field with the original Opportunity's Merchant Number.
